before.title: What we take with us
before.speaker: Survey crew
before.motivation: We came here to explore, and we leave with more than a survival story. Pack the specimens with their records, leave the camp useful to the next crew, and bring everyone to the ship.

area.label: What we take with us
area.travelText: Before launch, we return to camp for the final packing and handover. We bring the restored cargo hauler to carry our specimens and records back to the ascent depot.

caches.label: Camp departure stores
caches.narrative: The camp’s stored departure kit is ready for the final packing and handover.

before.completionText: The specimens, their records and our portrait are ready to travel. The handover beacon tells the next crew what we leave behind—including a living nursery.

before.title: A light that answers
before.speaker: Mission Control
before.motivation: The recovered ascent vehicle is waiting at the depot. We have the cabin tests and agreed rendezvous, and the camp handover is in place. Bring everyone and their discoveries to the waiting orbiter.

area.label: A light that answers
area.travelText: We return from camp to the ascent depot with the crew, specimens and records. The handover beacon stays at camp; our final flight will take us to the waiting orbiter.

caches.label: Ascent equipment and orbital destination
caches.narrative: The depot holds the ascent equipment. The orbital cabin is not part of these surface stores: it waits in orbit for our agreed rendezvous.

before.completionText: We’re through the orbiter’s hatch together, with our specimens and the picture from our table. The light that answered us has become our way home.

area.label: A light that answers
area.travelText: We bring the prepared hauler and its protected capsule load to the ascent depot with the crew. The handover beacon stays at camp, and the hauler will stay at the depot when we fly.

caches.label: Ascent equipment and orbital destination

after.completionText: We’re through the orbiter’s hatch together. Our return capsule is still secured in the docked ship beside us, with the specimens, their records and a copy of the picture from our table. The light that answered us has become our way home.
